tape_roll_station.name: Tape / give a line a surface
tape_roll_station.description: Three tape rolls on a temporary timber crate. Click once to set the start, then click again to place one continuous strip. Freehand drawing is optional. Marks follow their touched objects. Tape between separate physics bodies binds them with reversible native joints. Undo removes one span or stroke; Tidy refills and resets.
tape_roll_station.qfep_connection: A line changes from a measured relation into an authored mark, claim or boundary. The same two endpoints carry different implications when the roll changes.
interactions: Tap LMB / trigger at A then B: straight span
Optional freehand_draw=true: hold and drag for a surface stripe
Separate bodies bind; pull apart by hand to peel
UNDO removes a whole strip/stroke and its joints; TIDY clears and refills

parameters.parts: Independent poses for crate, board, plank, rolls, spindles, samples and controls

tape_roll_printed.name: Tape roll / printed
tape_roll_printed.description: Seven-and-a-half-centimetre ivory tape printed with what it reads where it lies: its length, what it runs from and to (or the one thing it marks), whether it joins them, its heading and slope, its number. The print is re-read when the things it is stuck to move. In note mode it prints an annotation instead.

parameters.print: environment (default): what the strip measures; note: the note text
parameters.bind_objects: Default true: separate physics bodies bind; false: marks and spans only

tape_roll_printed.qfep_connection: A line that says what it is and where: the mark becomes an annotation of the space it measures.

tape_roll_masking.name: Tape roll / masking
tape_roll_masking.description: Five-centimetre pale masking tape. Click start, then click end for one strip. Freehand surface stripes are opt-in. Separate physics bodies bind with native joints.

parameters.bind_objects: Default true: separate physics bodies bind; false: marks and spans only
parameters.freehand_draw: Default false: click start then end. True: hold and drag to sample surface stripes.

tape_roll_masking.qfep_connection: The measured segment becomes a temporary mark on a material surface.

parameters.bind_objects: Default true: separate physics bodies bind; false: marks and spans only
parameters.freehand_draw: Default false: click start then end. True: hold and drag to sample surface stripes.

tape_roll_pink.qfep_connection: The visitor chooses which line deserves attention.

tape_roll_barrier.name: Tape roll / striped barrier
tape_roll_barrier.description: Twelve-centimetre pink/black striped barrier tape. A visible boundary; spans can bind objects, without creating an invisible collision wall.

parameters.bind_objects: Default true: separate physics bodies bind; false: marks and spans only
parameters.freehand_draw: Default false: click start then end. True: hold and drag to sample surface stripes.

tape_roll_barrier.qfep_connection: A boundary is placed by someone; the strip makes its author visible.
